questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: Why vegan diets are the healthiest choice
How to count calories to lose weight
Gut microbes and diets that suit each person
Why identical twins always weigh the same
questions.why: They explain that everyone's gut microbes are unique, so some doctors recommend a personalised diet.

questions.q: What does Neil say about his own diet?
options: Lots of fruit and veg, and some meat
He's a vegan and never eats any meat
He follows the popular keto diet strictly
He eats a lot of meat every day
questions.why: Neil says he eats lots of fresh fruit and vegetables and only a little meat from time to time.

questions.q: According to recent research, where does our body's reaction to food mainly happen?
options: In the brain
On the tongue
In the stomach
In the gut
questions.why: Neil says it happens 'not in the brain, or tongue, or even the stomach, but in the gut'.

questions.q: What is true about the mix of microbes in our gut?
options: It is exactly the same in identical twins
It is different for everyone, even twins
It is the same in people from one family
It only changes when we get older
questions.why: Sam says the mix is unique and different for everyone, even identical twins.

questions.q: What did Dr Tim Spector discover about common food advice?
options: Much of it was based on weak or no evidence
It was all based on strong, modern research
It was only true for people who were overweight
It had been tested carefully on twins
questions.why: He says these 'myths' were based on 'flimsy or no evidence' and repeated so much nobody questioned them.

questions.q: What made Dr Spector realise that no two people have the same gut?
options: Doctors told him about new microscopes
Twins in his study ate completely different food
Identical twins could have very different weights
His own gut changed when he started a new diet
questions.why: It was the surprising differences in weight between identical twins that made him realise this.

questions.q: What did Dr Spector find in the guts of the skinnier twins?
options: Fewer types of microbes than their twins
No microbes at all in their samples
Exactly the same microbes as their twins
A wider variety of microbes
questions.why: He says in every case the skinnier twin had a more diverse microbiome, with more different species.

questions.q: Why does the programme suggest a personalised diet is best?
options: Because it lets you eat whatever you like
Everyone's gut microbes are different
Because it is cheaper than other diets
Because doctors say calories don't matter
questions.why: Neil says since everyone's microbes are different, a diet selecting the friendliest food for your gut is best.
